extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF text and figures; automated membrane/nucleic-acid placeholder claims were removed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: E2-42, E2-43, E2-78, and E2-79 inhibit HCV entry at a post-attachment step, supported by time-of-addition luciferase and qRT-PCR assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Entry-step assignment is cell-culture HCVcc evidence, not a structural proof for all HCV strains.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The four E2 peptides reduce HCVcc cell-to-cell transmission in Huh7.5/CD81 cultures.
direct_assay_types: HCV NS5A immunofluorescence focus transmission assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-level source supports reduced transmission; no exact table values are provided in local text.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: E2-42 associates with HCV envelope proteins E1 and E2 in GST pulldown/immunoblot assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct binding evidence is specific to E2-42; it should not be generalized to E2-43/E2-78/E2-79.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The peptides do not inhibit HCV RNA replication in the replicon assay, and E2-42 does not show receptor binding to CD81/occludin in the pulldown context.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: E2-42/E2-43/E2-78/E2-79 with receptor test specific to E2-42 panel context
mechanism_claims.limitations: Negative mechanism evidence bounds the claim; it does not identify a complete molecular mechanism.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP mechanism text includes packaging/release wording; final mechanism keeps this as contextual caution unless directly supported by source-located assays.
